summary: Iter24 SafeTradie refactor + polish (docs_module split / DocumentForm shadcn Calendar / generic table / /docs/stats / PATCH version+allowlist / auth.py extraction) validated end-to-end. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_refactor_and_new_endpoints.py (~3.1s) covering: (1) Auth routes extraction — POST /api/auth/register (201, token+user, email lowercased on persist), POST /api/auth/login (200, token+user, email matches), GET /api/auth/me (200, email matches), POST /api/auth/logout (200, success:true). (2) Regression /api/docs/types — returns dict with types(31) + categories(6: safety/worker/contractor/incident/plant/trade) + states. (3) Regression CRUD+PDF on jsa, whs_mgmt_plan, welding_procedure — POST 201, GET single 200 (no _id leak), GET /pdf returns application/pdf with %PDF magic, size>5KB, elapsed<30s ceiling (actual <2s); soft-delete cleanup. (4) New GET /api/docs/stats — bare session returns 401, authed returns {total:int, by_category:dict, by_doc_type:dict, recent:list len<=5} with no _id leak in recent[]. (5) PATCH version bump — create v=1, PATCH#1 returns v=2, PATCH#2 returns v=3, both PATCHes round-trip via re-GET. (6) PATCH allowlist — body {bogus_xxxxx,task,status} on jsa: response and re-GET both omit bogus_xxxxx, task=='ok', status=='in_use'. (7) POST allowlist — body {task,bogus_xxxxx} on jsa: response and re-GET both omit bogus_xxxxx. Frontend live on owner@safetradie.demo against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: /dashboard/document-library hub renders ALL 31 cat-type-* cards. DocumentForm Calendar (lift_plan/new field-lift_date): 'Pick a date' button present, NO native <input type=date>, popover opens on click, day cell '15' clickable, button text updates to ' 2026-05-15' confirming state set. DocumentForm datetime (hot_work_permit/new): field-start_datetime + field-start_datetime-time both present, NO native <input type=datetime-local>, 'Pick a date' button visible. Generic table fields render with no errors on hazardous_chemicals/field-chemicals, toolbox_talk_record/field-attendees, ccew/field-test_results, emp/field-aspects. Full create flow on lift_plan/new: doc-save click triggered POST /api/docs/lift_plan -> 200 OK, success toast 'Saved — LIFT-2026-0005' appeared, doc visible in subsequent /dashboard/document-library/lift_plan list view (LIFT-2026-0005 + LIFT-2026-0003) with inline PDF + archive icons in actions column.

integration_issues.issue: After doc-save success on /dashboard/document-library/lift_plan/new, the page navigated AWAY from the dashboard to the public marketing landing (/) instead of staying on the form (iter23 behaviour) or moving to /dashboard/document-library/lift_plan/{doc_id}. The save itself succeeds — POST /api/docs/lift_plan -> 200, toast 'Saved — LIFT-2026-0005' shown, doc appears in list view — so this is a post-save navigation regression introduced this iteration. Likely candidate: a window.location='/' or navigate('/') accidentally added to the save handler instead of navigate(`/dashboard/document-library/${type}/${doc_id}`). User has to manually navigate back to download the PDF from the list page.

action_items: (P1) Fix DocumentForm post-save navigation — currently redirects to '/' (marketing landing) instead of /dashboard/document-library/{type}/{doc_id}. Save+toast+persistence all work; only the navigation target is wrong. Confirmed on lift_plan/new during iter24 testing.

(Carryover from iter23) Add data-testid="doc-save-toast" so QA can poll for the success toast deterministically. Toast IS rendered (visible in iter24 screenshot: 'Saved — LIFT-2026-0005') but selector still not exposed.
(Carryover from iter23) Add data-testid="doc-row-{doc_id}" or doc-row-* on each row in the doc list table so list -> open flow can be automated; today rows are clickable but un-targetable.

(Nice-to-have) The /api/docs/types categories metadata returns 6 entries but only 4 (safety/worker/plant/trade) currently have registered doc types — 'contractor' and 'incident' are still empty placeholders. Either remove from /types response until populated, or annotate with count:0 so the hub can grey-out empty categories cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: docs_module.py split into docs_module.py (236 lines) + docs_pdf.py (1167 lines) + docs_registry.py (834 lines) is a good move BUT docs_pdf.py is now itself >700 line guideline. Recommend grouping render_* per-category (render_safety.py / render_trade.py / render_plant.py / render_worker.py) sharing a common _common_css helper. Same applies to docs_registry.py (also 834 lines) — split register_doc_type calls per category.

Auth routes extraction to /app/backend/routes/auth.py via register_auth_routes(api_router, db, User, get_current_user, hash_password, verify_password, make_jwt, trial_length_days) factory works correctly (4/4 endpoints pass). Long DI argument list is mildly painful — consider a lightweight AuthDeps dataclass or a service-locator dict so adding a new dep doesn't require updating every call site.

PATCH /api/docs/{id} version bump correctly increments 1->2->3 and field allowlist (built from spec.fields) silently drops unknown keys. Strongly recommend logging the dropped key names at debug level for forensics — silent drop could mask client-side typos that only surface as missing data downstream. Eg: logger.debug('docs: dropped unknown keys for %s/%s: %s', doc_type, doc_id, dropped).

WeasyPrint write_pdf wrapped in 30s asyncio timeout — verified PDFs still render in <2s for the 3 tested types. No regressions. Consider adding a metric/log when timeout triggers so SRE can spot pathological doc payloads.

/api/docs/stats endpoint correctly enforces auth (401 unauthenticated) and shape (total + by_category + by_doc_type + recent[<=5]). recent[] correctly excludes _id. Suggest adding a 'by_status' dict (draft/in_use/issued/archived counts) since the dashboard hub will likely need it next iteration for the per-card status pill counts.

Frontend DocumentForm.jsx generic 'table' type driven by field.columns=[{key,label}] | [{k,l}] is the right call and removes the 18+ if/else chain noted in iter23. Verified 4 legacy tables (chemicals/attendees/test_results/aspects) still render via TABLE_COLS lookup. Good cleanup.

shadcn Calendar + Popover replaces native date/datetime-local successfully. Verified zero <input type=date> / <input type=datetime-local> on lift_plan/new and hot_work_permit/new. Calendar popover opens, day click sets state ('Pick a date' -> '2026-05-15'). Recommend adding data-testid='date-popover-trigger-{field_key}' and 'date-popover-day-{date_iso}' for deterministic E2E.

Post-save navigation regression in DocumentForm (jumping to '/' marketing landing) is a real bug — see frontend_issues. The doc was correctly persisted (toast + list confirms) but the nav target is wrong. Minimum fix: replace navigate('/') (or window.location='/') with navigate(`/dashboard/document-library/${docType}`) so user lands on the list with their new doc visible.

rca_of_the_issue: Single post-save navigation regression: after POST /api/docs/{type} returns 200, DocumentForm save handler appears to call navigate('/') instead of navigate(`/dashboard/document-library/${docType}`) or navigate(`/dashboard/document-library/${docType}/${doc_id}`). Reproduction: login as owner -> /dashboard/document-library/lift_plan/new -> fill any field via Calendar -> click [data-testid=doc-save] -> network tab shows POST /api/docs/lift_plan -> 200 OK with body {doc_id:..., reference:'LIFT-2026-0005', ...} -> toast 'Saved — LIFT-2026-0005' appears top-right -> URL changes from /dashboard/document-library/lift_plan/new to / (public landing with LOG IN button). Mitigation: in /app/frontend/src/pages/docs/DocumentForm.jsx, locate the .then(...) success handler of the save mutation/fetch and replace any navigate('/') with navigate(`/dashboard/document-library/${docType}`). Verify by repeating reproduction — URL should become /dashboard/document-library/lift_plan and the new doc should appear at top of the list. All other refactor goals (docs_module split, docs_pdf, docs_registry, /docs/stats, PATCH version+allowlist, auth.py extraction, Calendar+Popover, generic table) verified working with no regressions.
